subject: Post-sale: CloudOps Health — transition & action items

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Post-sale: CloudOps Health — transition & action items

Hi team,

Happy to report CloudOps Health signed yesterday (Deal RDW-2026-3421). Quick context so CS has everything for a smooth ramp:

- ARR: $225,000 (annual)
- Contract start: 2026-12-01 (billing starts that day)
- Expected go-live (first production queries): target 2027-02-15
- Deployment: Private VPC deployment in us-west; customer requires SOC 2 evidence
- Auth: Okta SSO, customer will provide metadata
- Data: PII-filtered logs; retention 30 days; encryption at rest required

Attachments:
- SOW_v1.2.pdf (scope and milestones)
- MAP_CloudOps.xlsx (mutual action plan draft)
- Invoice_3421.pdf (initial invoice)

Open items for CS:
1) Owner assignment for kickoff and implementation plan
2) Confirm final SSO & network requirements (contact: security@cloudopshealth.com)
3) Confirm required training sessions and enablement materials
4) Agree on go-live acceptance criteria and metric owners

Hannah — can you please pick up the owner role or nominate someone? I recommend Marissa lead the implementation but leaving to you for capacity.

I'll remain on the thread for any contract/billing clarifications.

Thanks,
Dev

-- 
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Mike — congrats and welcome to Redwood! We'll take it from here on the implementation.

Internal note: assigning Marissa Cole as the primary Customer Success Owner for CloudOps Health. Marissa — please confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff within the next two weeks. Proposed windows:
- Tue 2026-11-30 10:00-12:00 PST
- Wed 2026-12-01 13:00-15:00 PST

Pre-kickoff ask for the customer (if possible to share before meeting):
- SSO metadata (Okta)
- Network diagram or firewall/IP allowlist requirements
- Point-of-contact for security and integration (security@cloudopshealth.com)
- Any specific onboarding SLAs or runbook expectations

I'll also circulate a short pre-kick checklist and a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on a smooth rollout.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt

Thanks Hannah — and thanks Dev.

We can do the kickoff on Wed 2026-12-01 13:00 PST (that slot works best for our engineering and security leads). I've looped in our security team (security@cloudopshealth.com) and onboarding alias. A couple of quick items from our side:

- We'll need a short checklist of required firewall rules and the public IP ranges for the VPC connector.
- We prefer SSO SAML metadata via secure transfer; I can ask our Okta admin to provide the XML before the meeting.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood needs VPN access or if the VPC peering will be sufficient?
- We received the DocuSign link for SOW and will sign by EOD tomorrow.

Attached: none (we'll upload network details to the onboarding alias once we have them).

Regards,
Mike
